div.l: Therto he coude endite ⁊and make a thyng
Ther coude no man pynche at hese writyng
And eủery statut coude he pleyn be rote
He rod but homely in a medely cote
Gyrt with a seynt of silk wᵗith barrys smale
Of hese aray telle I no lengere tale
¶ A fran̄keleyn was in hese cūmpanye Frankeleyn
Whit was hese berd as is þe daysie
Of cōmplexioıı̄un he was sanguyn
Wel louede be þᵉ morwe a soppe in wyn
To leuyn in delit was euere hese wone
For he was epicurꝰus owene sone
Thaᵗ Tha That held opynyoıı̄un þᵗat pleyn delyt
Was uery felicite parfyt
An housholdere ⁊and þᵗat a gret was he
Seynt Ielion he was in that cuntre
Hese bred hese ale was alwey aftyr on
A betere enuynede man was nower non
Wᵗith oute bake mete was neủere his hous
Of fysch ⁊and flesch ⁊and þᵗat so plentyuoꝰus
It snowede in his mouth of meᵗᵉ me mete ⁊and drynk
Of alle deynteis that men coude þynk
Aftyr þᵉ sundery sesenys of the ȝer
So chaıı̄ungede he hese mete ⁊and hese soper
Ful manye a fat perterych hadde he īn mewe
And many a brēm / ⁊and manye a luce īn stewe
Wo was hese cook / but ȝif hese sauce were
Poynaunt ⁊and redy al hese geere
His table dormaıı̄unt in hese halle alwey
Stod redy keủered / al the longe day
At sessioūnys þ̉ere was he lord ⁊and syre
Ful ofte tyme he was knght of the schyre
An Anlas ⁊and a gipser al of sylk
Heng at hese gyrdil whit as morwȳn mylk
A schirreue hadde he ben ⁊and countour
Was nowʰer nower nowher swich a vanasour
